question: Which of the following is NOT a plantation crop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wheat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plantation Crop**:

 
 
• **Plantations **are a type of commercial farming where a **single crop of tea, coffee, sugarcane, cashew, rubber, banana or cotton** are grown.
 
• Large amounts of labour and capital are required.
 
• The produce may be processed on the farm itself or in nearby factories. Major plantations are found in the tropical regions of the world.
 
• **Examples**:** Rubber, Tea. Coffee, coconut**, etc.
 
 
 
• **Wheat is not a plantation crop because plantation crops are grown for profit. Wheat is grown in a large scale of hectare ****worldwide.​​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wheat**:

 
 
• Wheat is the main Rabi** crop in India.**
 
• The total area under the crop is about **29.8 million** hectares in the country.
 
• The production of Wheat has increased significantly from** 75.81 Million MT in 2011-12.**
 
• The productivity of wheat which was** 2602 kg/hectare in 2004-05 **has increased to **3140kg/hectare in 2011-12.**
 
• major Wheat Producing States: **Haryana, Punjab, and Uttar Pradesh.**
